title: Input-tape answers after signed movement
statement: Let $M$ be a finite-tape machine over Boolean symbols, let $x$ be its input, and let $c$ be a configuration on $x$. For Boolean values $\mathrm{neg}$ and $\mathrm{bl}$ and a natural number $a$, the table answer for the input-tape symbol selector, after $a$ simulated moves in direction $\mathrm{neg}$, is the blank-symbol test applied to the input symbol at signed offset $(-1)^{\mathrm{neg}}a$ from the current input-head position. The offset is $-a$ when $\mathrm{neg}$ is true and $a$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: A finite-tape machine over Boolean symbols
